Welcome to Mid-Iowa Cooperative
Mid-Iowa has a strong motto of Good Land, Good People, Good Advice.
Mid-Iowa Cooperative began business on April 25, 1907. We currently own and/or operate fifteen grain facilities. Four of our grain locations, Beaman, Klostermann, Jesup, and Sinclair also offer full-service feed mills with full delivery service for both bag and bulk feed. Mid-Iowa Milling, LLC carries a full line of feed products, ranging from cattle, swine, poultry and other animal feed including cat & dog food. Mid-Iowa has eight full-time Grain Originators on staff providing grain marketing opportunities, crop insurance, and brokerage. Mid-Iowa has twenty-five grain semis running full-time. We offer grain hauling off the farm or straight out of the field. We can haul this grain back to one of our grain locations or haul it to an end user.
Powering Growth in Agricultur e
Mid-Iowa Cooperative is the majority owner of Mid-Iowa Milling, LLC. These four mills combined have capacity to manufacture more than a million tons of feed per year. Mid-Iowa Coop played a leading role in the development of Shell Rock and Platinum Soybean Processing Plants to bring additional value to our grain producers and their crops.
